buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Certification, Compliance, and Quality Assurance and installation -All material equipment and in stallation practices shall comply with internationally recognized structured cabling standard. The contracto r shall ensure that the installed infrastructure is tested, certified, and documented in guarantee performan

ce and reliability. (a)Applicable standard (i)TIA/EIA-568-D Structured Cabling Standard (ii) ISO/IEC-606-C Generic Cabling Standard (iii) ANSI/TIA-607-C Administration and Labeling Standard (iv) ANSI/TIA-607-D Grounding and Bonding Requirements (v) IEEE 802.3 Ethernet Standard (b) Cabling Certification Requirement -Every installed network point shall undergo certification testin g using a calibrated Fluke Network Cable Analyzer or equivalent certified testing equipment. All 250 data p o ints shall achieve a PASS result in accordance with Cat6 performance standards. (c) Network Testing Requirement (i) Wire map verification (ii) Cable length measurement (iii) Insertion Loss (iv) Return loss (v) Near-End Crosstalk (vi) Power Sum NEXT (vii) Alien Crosstalk (viii) Channel performance testing 2. Documentation (a) Fluke test reports for all data points (b) Fiber test reports (c) Cable numbering schedule (d) Rack layout drawing (e) Network topology diagram (f) As-Built drawing . 4. Swachh Bharat Mission(SBM) Maintenance of Electrical Works The shift operator shall 1.Take help of trained and certified workers to install, maintain, or repair electrical equipment. 2.Ensure that live-wire work is conducted by trained workers. 3.Keep the minimum approach distances outlined for specific live line voltages. 4.Ensure proper use of special safety equipment and procedures when working near, or on, exposed energized parts of an electrical system. 5.Stay at least 10 feet (3 meters) away from overhead wires during on-site activities. 6.Never operate electrical equipment while you are standing in water. 7.If working in damp locations, inspect electric cords and equipment to ensure that they are in good condition. Note :Specific work item details shall be prescribed by Authority before seeking proposals on AMC. 5. Generic

Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software.
